transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because I keep getting pulled off whatever I’m trying to do. Like, I’ll start working on an application, and then some noise outside, or my phone, or just some random thought… I’m somewhere else before I even realize it.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?
Yeah… pretty often. If I’m sitting with someone, my leg’s usually bouncing, or I’m clicking a pen, messing with my keys… half the time I don’t even notice I’m doing it.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Yeah… I guess so. I cut people off a lot, mostly my mom or the counselor. Like, something pops into my head and I just say it before they’re even done talking.
Do you have trouble completing tasks or assignments at work or school?

Yeah… I do. I’ve missed some training deadlines, and I’ve had to redo applications because I didn’t finish them right or on time. It’s kind of kept me from moving forward with becoming an automotive technician, even though I think I’d be okay with the actual hands-on part.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?
Yeah… I do. Mostly with my mom or my counselor. I’ll have an answer in my head and just say it before they’re done talking.
Do you have trouble focusing or staying on task in your daily life outside of work or school?

Yeah… outside of that too. Like I’ll put on a repair video or try to read a tool manual, and a few minutes later I realize I’ve just been staring at it. I have to go back because none of it really stayed in my head.
Were you also fidgety or restless when you were a kid?
Yeah, I think so. In elementary school I was always getting moved around in class… teachers said I talked out of turn, forgot homework, or rushed through worksheets and made dumb mistakes.
Have you experienced these symptoms consistently since you were a kid, or have they come and gone over time?
It’s kind of been there since I was younger, but it got really disruptive about… almost two years ago. Like a year and ten months, after my soccer injury messed up my normal routine.
Do you think your difficulty with focus and staying on task is more of a problem for you than your restlessness and impulsivity?

Yeah… I think the focus part is more of the problem. I just get pulled off by anything — like a car outside, my phone, or even some random thought — and then I’m doing something else before I really notice.
Have these difficulties with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity caused you significant problems in your relationships or daily life?

Yeah… daily life, mostly. I’ve missed training deadlines and had to redo applications a few times, so I’m still kind of stuck instead of moving forward toward being an automotive technician. Which is frustrating, because I know I can do the hands-on part.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity in multiple settings, such as at home, with friends, or in different jobs?
I’m not totally sure. I mean… it’s not just one place, I guess, but I haven’t really kept track of it like that. It comes up in normal stuff day to day.
Were these difficulties with focus and restlessness present before you were 12 years old?

Yeah… I think so. In elementary school, teachers used to move my seat a lot because I’d talk when I wasn’t supposed to. I’d forget homework too, and I’d rush through worksheets and make dumb mistakes.
Have these difficulties with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity caused you significant problems in your relationships?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I’m not really sure. I haven’t thought about it that way.
Have you experienced problems with friends or family because of your difficulties with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity?
Yeah… sometimes. I guess I cut people off a lot, like my mom or my counselor. An answer comes into my head and I just say it before they’re finished. It can annoy people.
Do you experience these difficulties with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity at home, with friends, and in different situations, or are they mainly in one setting?
I’m not totally sure. I mean… it’s not just one place, I don’t think, but I haven’t really paid close attention to it like that.
Have you lost any friends because of your difficulties with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity?
I don’t think so… not like someone stopped being my friend because of it. At least, I haven’t really noticed that.
Have your symptoms ever caused you to have trouble keeping friends or getting along with family members?
Yeah, a little. Mostly I interrupt people… like my mom, or my counselor. I’ll think of an answer and just say it before they’re done. It doesn’t usually go over great.
Would you say that your symptoms are currently causing you mild, moderate, or severe problems in your daily life?

I’d say… moderate, probably. It’s not like everything is falling apart, but it is getting in the way. I’ve missed training deadlines and had to redo applications enough that I’m still not really moving forward toward becoming an automotive technician, even though I think I could handle the hands-on part.
Have your symptoms ever caused significant problems in your relationships with friends or family?

Yeah… somewhat. I don’t know if I’d call it significant, but I do cut people off a lot. Like with my mom, or my counselor, I’ll have an answer pop in my head and I just say it before they’re done. It can cause problems.
Would you describe the problems caused by your symptoms as mild, moderate, or severe?

Moderate, I guess. I’ve missed training deadlines and had to redo applications, so I’m still not really moving forward with becoming an automotive technician… even though I think I could do the hands-on work.
